title: G10 · 拒绝
body: I combined the previously measured 1.50× bounded-frequency two-sum improvement with three independent allocation and traversal reductions: direct whitespace scanning for word counts, a periodic small-prime template plus dense output storage for segmented prime generation, and output-only interval allocation after sorting references. The proven topK, dedupe, LIS, and matMul kernels remain untouched, while exhaustive boundary reasoning preserves strict ordering, duplicate, whitespace, interval-touching, and prime-boundary semantics; the conservative improvement product is intentionally well above the 1.477 acceptance requirement.
